Package co.edu.unbosque.model.persistence

package co.edu.unbosque.model.persistence
This package contains the classes in charge of to handle the persistence of game data, such as teams, units and games. In addition, it provides an interface for CRUD operations and specific classes for file handling and object serialization . file handling and object serialization. Classes included: - EquipoDAO: This class handles CRUD operations for the teams in the game. It allows to create, update, delete and search for teams by their color. In addition, it manages the creation and deletion of units within each team. - PartidaDAO: Handles CRUD operations for games in the game.
